cues.en: Because when we were talking about me coming back to Yavsi, he said, well, could you give a keynote on the features of Pearl six that make life better even for beginners?
cues.zh: 因为之前聊到我回 YAPC 时，他说：“你能不能做个主题演讲，讲讲 Perl 6 有哪些特性让初学者也能过得更轻松？”

cues.en: So given that brief, it was completely natural that I would decide that this keynote I'm going to talk about
cues.zh: 既然接到了这个要求，那我理所当然地决定在本次演讲中

cues.en: basically
cues.zh: 基本上

cues.en: all of these topics.
cues.zh: 把所有这些话题全讲一遍。

cues.en: And the way I got here was I started out by asking myself, well,
cues.zh: 我是怎么想到这些的呢？起初我自问：

cues.en: what is it that beginners would do with PERL six? And I I guess that always depends on the kind of beginners we're talking about. If they're just beginners in PERL six, if they're used to PERL five, for example, then I pretty much expect that you're gonna be doing the same sorts of things that you do in PERL five in PERL six, just enjoying it more.
cues.zh: 初学者到底会拿 Perl 6 做什么？我想这取决于我们讨论的是哪类初学者。如果他们只是 Perl 6 的新手，比如原本习惯用 Perl 5，那我完全认为你在 Perl 6 里做的会和在 Perl 5 里差不多，只是写起来更享受。

cues.en: If you're new to Pearl entirely,
cues.zh: 如果你完全没接触过 Perl，

cues.en: then it's very likely that what you're gonna be doing with Pearl six is what you were doing with whatever languages you have escaped from
cues.zh: 那你在 Perl 6 里的写法，多半和你从之前那个“弃坑”的语言里带过来的习惯差不多，

cues.en: and just enjoying it more.
cues.zh: 只是写起来更顺心。

cues.en: But I wanted to go a little bit further than that. I think, what about people who are beginners
cues.zh: 但我想讲得更深一点。我在想，那些刚学编程的

cues.en: in programming?
cues.zh: 真正新手呢？

cues.en: I thought, well, where can I find a list of beginners in programming? And of course, you can find it on Wikipedia.
cues.zh: 我琢磨着，上哪儿能找到一份编程初学者的清单呢？当然是在 Wikipedia 上了。

cues.en: When you look for a list of beginners in programming, you find these names.
cues.zh: 当你去查编程先驱名单时，会看到这些名字。

cues.en: So I decided I would talk about what they did and what they might have been able to do if they'd had Pearl six.
cues.zh: 所以我决定聊聊他们做过的事，以及如果他们当年有 Perl 6 能做出什么。

cues.en: So let's get started. Let's start with this lady. This is Ada King, the Countess of Lovelace.
cues.zh: 那么我们开始吧。先从这位女士讲起，她是 Ada King，也就是 Lovelace 伯爵夫人。

cues.en: And she of course is famous for publishing the first ever computer algorithm. And the great thing about the Internet is if you wanna see it, you can actually see it online if you wanna go out there and find that. And it was fantastic because she even had coding tables
cues.zh: 她当然是以发表了人类历史上第一个计算机算法而闻名。互联网最棒的一点就是，只要你想看，随时都能在网上找到它。这太不可思议了，因为她甚至准备了编码表

cues.en: for how to run the analytical engine.
cues.zh: 用来指导如何运行分析机。

cues.en: So this very first algorithm was about computing Bernoulli numbers.
cues.zh: 这有史以来第一个算法是用来计算伯努利数的。

cues.en: And of course, since that particular publication, there have been better algorithms for it. And here's probably about the best of them, the Akiyama Tanagawa algorithm
cues.zh: 当然，自那次发表以来，出现了更好的算法。而其中最优秀的可能要数 Akiyama-Tanigawa 算法，

cues.en: written in Pearl six.
cues.zh: 这是用 Perl 6 编写的版本。

cues.en: Now if you're not very familiar with Pearl six, the first thing you'll notice here is how much this looks like a modern Pearl five
cues.zh: 如果你对 Perl 6 不太熟悉，首先会注意到它看起来非常像现代 Perl 5 的

cues.en: implementation.
cues.zh: 一种实现。

cues.en: In fact, there are only a few syntactic differences,
cues.zh: 事实上，语法差异只有寥寥几处，

cues.en: but I would argue those syntactic differences are valuable and make life better.
cues.zh: 但我认为这些语法差异很有价值，让编程体验更好了。

cues.en: So the most obvious one is we rejigged how the for
cues.zh: 最显而易见的一点是我们重新设计了 for

cues.en: loop syntax works. So in Pearl six, you say for this list of things
cues.zh: 循环的语法。在 Perl 6 里，你写 for 加上这个列表，

cues.en: and then you say, and they feed into
cues.zh: 然后表示让它们流入

cues.en: some iterator variable which I'm going to use in the loop.
cues.zh: 某个要在循环内部使用的迭代变量中。

cues.en: So that's very very cool
cues.zh: 这就非常非常酷，

cues.en: and of course, when you have your list
cues.zh: 当然，当你有了一个列表，

cues.en: in PERL six, you can do all kinds of things you can't easily do in PERL five. You can count up from zero which you can do in PERL five. You can count down from m just as easily.
cues.zh: 在 Perl 6 里你可以做到各种在 Perl 5 里很难做到的事。你可以从 0 开始递增计数，这在 Perl 5 里也能做；但你也能同样轻松地从 m 开始递减倒数。

cues.en: And indeed, what we found that many people wanna do is they wanna count from zero to n minus one.
cues.zh: 事实上我们发现，很多人真正想做的是从 0 数到 n 减 1。

cues.en: So we made an operator for that.
cues.zh: 于是我们专门为此设计了一个运算符。

cues.en: You wanna count 20 times, that's what you're doing there. We think that this will decrease the use of minus one by about 80%
cues.zh: 想数 20 次，这么写就行。我们觉得这能把“-1”的使用率降低大概 80%，

cues.en: in Perl code.
cues.zh: 在 Perl 代码中。

cues.en: So the other interesting thing about this is the way this works when we are setting up the iterator variable
cues.zh: 另一个有趣的地方在于设置迭代变量的机制，

cues.en: is that that iterator variable is actually just a parameter of the block. In PERL six, all blocks can have parameters
cues.zh: 这个迭代变量其实就是代码块的一个参数。在 Perl 6 中，所有代码块都可以带参数，

cues.en: and so the for loop just takes two arguments, a list and a block with a parameter and the parameter tells you
cues.zh: 所以 for 循环其实只接收两个参数：一个列表和一个带参数的代码块，这个参数会指明

cues.en: what the name of the iterator variable is. If you don't give it a name, it gets an automatic parameter and that automatic parameter is
cues.zh: 迭代变量的名字是什么。如果你不给它命名，它会得到一个默认参数，这个默认参数就是

cues.en: dollar underscore.
The
cues.zh: 还有

cues.en: next thing I really like about Pearl six
cues.zh: 我非常喜欢 Perl 6 的另一处特性，

cues.en: is that none of the control structures in the language require you to put parentheses in.
cues.zh: 就是这门语言中所有的控制结构都不再强制要求加括号。

cues.en: You still can if it makes you feel better,
cues.zh: 要是加了括号让你感觉更好，你依然可以加，

cues.en: but it's not necessary anymore. And anything that moves us away from Lisp is a good thing.
cues.zh: 但已经完全没必要了。任何能让我们远离 Lisp 的改变都是好事。

cues.en: The
cues.zh: 另外

cues.en: other thing that I like about Pearl six
cues.zh: 我喜欢 Perl 6 的另一件事，

cues.en: is we made a fundamental change in the way that you access an array or indeed a hash.
cues.zh: 就是我们从根本上改变了访问数组乃至哈希的方式。

cues.en: So in Pearl five, if you think back to when you were learning Pearl five, maybe that was last week, maybe that was a decade ago,
cues.zh: 回想一下你学 Perl 5 的时候，可能是在上周，也可能是在十年前，

cues.en: one of the biggest jobs of the beginner in Pearl five is to try and work out which sigil to use.
cues.zh: Perl 5 初学者最头疼的事情之一，就是搞清楚该用哪个 sigil（前缀符号）。

cues.en: And basically the method we mostly use is I'll try all of them until one of them stops complaining.
cues.zh: 我们基本上最常用的办法就是挨个试，直到它不再报错为止。

cues.en: Well, in Pearl six, we completely change the way that works.
cues.zh: 而在 Perl 6 里，我们彻底改变了这种机制。

cues.en: In Pearl six, if it's an array, you use an at sign.
cues.zh: 在 Perl 6 中，如果是数组，就用 @ 符号。

cues.en: Always.
cues.zh: 永远如此。

cues.en: Same with hashes, always a percentage sign. Same with scalars, always a dollar sign,
cues.zh: 哈希也是，永远用 % 号；标量永远用 $ 符号，

cues.en: less than over. That's it. So in other words, we took this Pearl five table of what do you use when
cues.zh: 规则就这么简单。换句话说，我们把 Perl 5 那个复杂的对照表，

cues.en: and we made it this table instead.
cues.zh: 精简成了现在这张表。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: I really like that because it really does make everyone's life easier except people who are coding in both PERL five and PERL six at the same time.
cues.zh: 我非常喜欢这一点，因为它确实让大家的日子好过多了——除了那些同时写 Perl 5 和 Perl 6 的人。

cues.en: Your lives will be misery.
cues.zh: 你们的日子可就惨了。

cues.en: The last thing I like is in PERL six, if you see curly brackets, that's a block of code even if the curly brackets happen to be inside a double quoted string.
cues.zh: 最后一件我喜欢的事是：在 Perl 6 里，只要看到花括号，它就是一个代码块，哪怕花括号恰好在双引号字符串内部。

cues.en: So inside a double quoted string, you come across a block of code, it executes the block of code, interpolates whatever the result was.
cues.zh: 因此在双引号字符串中遇到代码块时，它会执行这段代码，并将结果插值进去。

cues.en: And now putting subroutine calls inside a double quoted string is that easy. You will never use the concatenation operator again.
cues.zh: 现在在双引号字符串里调用子程序就这么简单，你再也不需要用字符串拼接运算符了。

cues.en: So let's run this little bit of code
cues.zh: 我们来运行一下这段小代码，

cues.en: and see what it does. Well, what it does is compute the Bernoulli numbers. It's very exciting, I know. And if you're familiar with the Bernoulli number, it's a weird sequence. It kind of starts out sane and then every second one decides it's gonna be zero forever
cues.zh: 看看会发生什么。它做的是计算伯努利数，我知道这很让人兴奋。如果你熟悉伯努利数，就会知道这是个很诡异的数列：开头还挺正常，接着每隔一项就永远成了 0，

cues.en: and all the other ones just can't kinda have random values.
cues.zh: 而其余各项看起来简直像一堆随机数。

cues.en: I want you to memorize that particular list
cues.zh: 我希望大家记住这串数值，

cues.en: because I wanna show you the same thing in PERL five. Watch carefully. That's PERL five version. Note how similar.
cues.zh: 因为我想给大家展示一下在 Perl 5 里跑同样代码的效果。仔细看，这是 Perl 5 版本，注意看它们有多像。

cues.en: Oh, oops.
cues.zh: 噢，糟糕。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: It's
cues.zh: 真是一门

cues.en: great language.
cues.zh: 优秀的语言。

cues.en: So if we pull those two lists up, you'll see that
cues.zh: 如果我们把这两组数据摆在一起，你就会发现：

cues.en: some of the PERL five values are right, some of them are kinda right,
cues.zh: Perl 5 的结果有些是对的，有些马马虎虎算对，

cues.en: and then things go horribly horribly wrong because of the accumulated rounding errors.
cues.zh: 接着由于累积的舍入误差，结果变得错得离谱。

cues.en: Because in PERL five, what do we use? We use your native floating point notation to do these calculations
cues.zh: 因为在 Perl 5 里，我们用的是什么？用的是原生浮点数表示法来做这些计算，

cues.en: and as we go on in the iteration,
cues.zh: 随着迭代不断推进，

cues.en: things go horribly wrong.
cues.zh: 计算就彻底崩了。

cues.en: So what is it that Pearl six offers to beginners?
cues.zh: 那么 Perl 6 究竟给初学者带来了什么？

cues.en: Well, for a start, it offers them a cleaner syntax.
cues.zh: 首先，它提供了更干净的语法。

cues.en: Just a simple syntactic cleanup that's simpler to understand. But maybe more importantly,
cues.zh: 仅仅是简单的语法清理，就更易于理解。但也许更重要的是，

cues.en: it offers cleaner semantics,
cues.zh: 它提供了更清晰的语义，

cues.en: more do what you meanness.
cues.zh: 更有那种“懂你所想”（DWIM）的感觉。

cues.en: And so I was thinking about semantics and beginners, and that naturally leads me to this guy,
cues.zh: 于是我思考起语义和初学者，这自然让我联想到了这位，

cues.en: Alan Turing.
cues.zh: Alan Turing。

cues.en: Famous, of course, for inventing the Allen machine,
cues.zh: 当然，他以发明“艾伦机”闻名，

cues.en: Which would have gone much much better if he'd called it the I tape infinity.
cues.zh: 要是他当初把它叫做“iTape Infinity”，反响肯定好得多。

cues.en: So you know all know the Turing machine. You know, you've got a tape you can write on it. You can read from it. You've got states to move. I love the Turing machine. You can build a Turing machine out of just about anything. You can build it out of Mechano.
cues.zh: 大家肯定都知道图灵机。有一根纸带，可以读写，还有状态转换。我非常喜欢图灵机。你几乎可以用任何东西来造图灵机。你可以用 Meccano 积木搭，

cues.en: You can build it out of Lego. You can build it out of Excel.
cues.zh: 可以用 Lego 搭，可以用 Excel 做。

cues.en: But my favorite implementation
cues.zh: 但我最喜欢的一个图灵机实现，

cues.en: of the Turing machine was the person
cues.zh: 出自一位

cues.en: who implemented it
cues.zh: 把它实现

cues.en: in the template
cues.zh: 在模板

cues.en: system
cues.zh: 系统

cues.en: of c plus plus.
cues.zh: 里的人，C++ 的模板系统。

cues.en: Not in c plus plus, in the template system.
cues.zh: 不是用 C++ 写的，而是在模板系统里。

cues.en: So there are no executable statements in this Turing machine.
cues.zh: 所以这个图灵机里没有任何可执行语句。

cues.en: You can pilot and the Turing machine runs.
cues.zh: 只要编译一下，图灵机就运行了。

cues.en: In other words, the template mechanism of of c plus plus is Turing complete,
cues.zh: 换句话说，C++ 的模板机制是图灵完备的，

cues.en: which tells you everything you need to know about c plus plus.
cues.zh: 这足以说明 C++ 是个什么语言了。

cues.en: So I thought, what would a Turing machine look like in Pearl six?
cues.zh: 于是我想，在 Perl 6 里图灵机会长什么样？

cues.en: This is the complete implementation
cues.zh: 这就是它的

cues.en: for it. So a Turing machine needs five bits of information.
cues.zh: 完整实现。一台图灵机需要五个要素的信息。

cues.en: You need to tell me what state to start in. You need to tell me what the rules of transition are. You need to tell me
cues.zh: 你得告诉我起始状态是什么，状态转移规则是什么，你得告诉我

cues.en: where the head's going to be, what the tape looks like initially, and when I should stop.
cues.zh: 读写头放在哪、纸带初始长什么样，以及什么时候该停下来。

cues.en: And then you go into a big infinite loop
cues.zh: 然后你就进入一个大的无限循环

cues.en: and you print out the current state of the tape.
cues.zh: 然后打印出纸带的当前状态。

cues.en: And then if you're in the halt state, you finish. And otherwise, you update what's under the read... Under the head position and in the tape,
cues.zh: 然后如果你处于停机状态，就结束。否则，你就更新读头下方……读写头位置和纸带上的内容，

cues.en: what the state is now, and
cues.zh: 当前状态是什么，以及

cues.en: do you move the head left or right?
cues.zh: 你是把读写头左移还是右移？

cues.en: And the only bit of this that's not actually about the algorithm itself is these last two lines.
cues.zh: 而这段代码里唯一实际上不属于算法本身的部分，就是最后两行。

cues.en: And the problem here is in PERL five and PERL six, we've got these unbounded
cues.zh: 这里的问题在于，在 Perl 5 和 Perl 6 中，我们有这些无界

cues.en: arrays, which we all love because they're incredibly useful, but they're only semi unbounded.
cues.zh: 数组，我们都喜欢它们，因为非常有用，但它们只是半无界的。

cues.en: They're only semi infinite. So if you happen to move the head off the start of the tape, if you wanna simulate an infinite tape, then you've gotta move everything down and move the head back on, and that's what those two lines are doing. They're exactly the same as if you did them in PEL five.
cues.zh: 它们只是半无限的。所以如果你碰巧把读写头移出纸带起点，而你想模拟一条无限纸带，那就得把所有内容往下移，再把读写头移回来，那两行做的正是这件事。它们和在 Perl 5 里做的一模一样。

cues.en: Now some things that I like about this from the language point of view is that in PERL six, we have an incredibly advanced mechanism
cues.zh: 从语言角度看，我喜欢这点的原因之一是，在 Perl 6 中，我们有一个极其先进的机制

cues.en: for specifying the signature of a subroutine. You can do all kinds of amazing things. Probably the most useful is you can create a subroutine whose parameters are named parameters. That's what the colons in front of those parameters are for. It says, these are named parameters which means when you call them, you have to call them with a name in front of them.
cues.zh: 用于指定子程序的签名。你可以做各种惊人的事情。最有用的可能是你可以创建一个子程序，其参数是命名参数。那些参数前面的冒号就是干这个的。它表示这些是命名参数，意味着调用它们时，必须在它们前面带上名字。

cues.en: And anyone who's written large scale code knows this is the way to write parameter calls if you possibly can because in six months time you come back and you remember these. And more importantly, when someone comes back and say, oh, we should alphabetize
cues.zh: 任何写大规模代码的人都知道，只要有可能，就该这样写参数调用，因为六个月后你回来时还能记得这些。更重要的是，当有人回来说，哦，我们应该按字母顺序排列

cues.en: them or something like that and changes the order, name parameters don't care.
cues.zh: 它们或诸如此类的东西并改变顺序时，命名参数不在乎。

cues.en: The name tells it which variable to go into so it always works, you don't have to remember the order of things. And as I get older, not having to remember the order of things becomes increasingly valuable to me.
cues.zh: 名字告诉它该进入哪个变量，所以它总是有效，你不必记住顺序。而且随着我变老，不必记住顺序对我来说变得越来越有价值。

cues.en: But there's more to this as well. In most languages that have named parameters, the named parameters are optional
cues.zh: 但这还不止这些。在大多数有命名参数的语言中，命名参数是可选的

cues.en: and they are in PERL six as well, but you can also make them required
cues.zh: 在 Perl 6 中它们也是可选的，但你也可以让它们成为必需的

cues.en: and you do this just by screaming them.
cues.zh: 而你只需对它们“尖叫”就能做到。

cues.en: State, roles.
cues.zh: State、roles。

cues.en: If you don't like to scream, then you can just say they are required,
cues.zh: 如果你不喜欢“尖叫”，那也可以直接说它们是必需的，

cues.en: but that's more fun.
cues.zh: 但那样更有趣。

cues.en: Normally,
cues.zh: 通常，

cues.en: as in Pearl five, Pearl six parameters are passed as aliases,
cues.zh: 和在 Perl 5 中一样，Perl 6 的参数是按别名传递的，

cues.en: But sometimes what you want is a copy of the thing that you can mess around with and not destroy the original argument.
cues.zh: 但有时你想要的是这个东西的副本，这样你可以随意折腾它，而不会破坏原始参数。

cues.en: So you can say in pearl six very easily, I wanna copy. In pearl five, you have to actually manually copy it into a variable yourself.
cues.zh: 所以在 Perl 6 里你可以很轻松地说，我想要副本。而在 Perl 5 里，你必须自己手动把它复制到一个变量里。

cues.en: This makes it easy. And of course, the optional arguments, it's also nice if they can have defaults
cues.zh: 这让事情变得很简单。当然，可选参数要是能有默认值就更好了，

cues.en: and they can have defaults. By the way, you get that in Pearl five now as long as you're using Pearl five twenty and later.
cues.zh: 而且它们确实可以有。顺便提一句，只要使用 Perl 5.20 及以上版本，你在 Perl 5 里就能这么用了。

cues.en: So very cool mechanism for creating really nice APIs
cues.zh: 这是个非常酷的机制，可以用来构建非常优雅的 API，

cues.en: to your subroutines.
cues.zh: 供你的子程序使用。

cues.en: And then other cool stuff.
cues.zh: 还有其他很酷的东西。

cues.en: I never wanna have to write wild one
cues.zh: 我再也不想写 while 1

cues.en: or for Dracula again.
cues.zh: 或者 Dracula 风格的 for(;;) 了。

cues.en: And I don't have to.
cues.zh: 而且我也不必再这么写了。

cues.en: I love the fact that in PERRL six, almost anything that you'd want to interpolate into a double quoted string including
cues.zh: 我非常喜欢 Perl 6 的一点是，几乎任何你想插入双引号字符串的内容，包括

cues.en: a method call on an array which calls another method to map the values
cues.zh: 数组上的方法调用，且该调用还会调用另一个方法来 map 这些值，

cues.en: just works. And that's all just interpolated
cues.zh: 都能直接生效。而这一切都会直接被插值

cues.en: into the string. What this is doing is it's saying, give me the tape, give me the key and values of the tape that is position
cues.zh: 进字符串里。这行代码做的是：给我纸带，给我纸带的键和值，也就是位置

cues.en: and value.
cues.zh: 和对应的值。

cues.en: And if the position is at the head position, draw the cell with the square brackets around it and otherwise don't draw it with the square brackets around it. And when I show you this running, you'll see that makes the head position visible
cues.zh: 如果该位置恰好是读写头的位置，就在单元格两边加上方括号，否则就不加。稍后我运行演示时，你们就会看到这让读写头的位置

cues.en: on the tape.
cues.zh: 在纸带上清晰可见。

cues.en: You're gonna love it.
cues.zh: 你们肯定会喜欢的。

cues.en: I love the fact that when I wanna sleep for one tenth of a second, I can just say sleep for one tenth of a second
cues.zh: 我很喜欢的一点是，当我想 sleep 0.1 秒时，直接写 sleep 0.1 秒就行，

cues.en: without having to load in a module
cues.zh: 不需要额外加载模块，

cues.en: or forget to load in the module and then have it round down to zero.
cues.zh: 也不用担心忘了加载模块而导致时间被向下取整为零。

cues.en: I love the fact that hashes
cues.zh: 我很喜欢哈希的一点是，

cues.en: you can look up
cues.zh: 你可以直接查找，

cues.en: with a percentage left on the front. So here I'm looking up in the rule hash
cues.zh: 在前面保留一个百分号就行。这里我在 rule 哈希中查找

cues.en: for a particular state and a particular thing under the head or if I can't find anything under the head then just the empty space,
cues.zh: 某个特定状态以及读写头下的特定字符，如果读写头下什么都没有，那就匹配空格，

cues.en: give me the rule for that which will be a nested hash eventually.
cues.zh: 把对应的规则返回给我，它最终会是一个嵌套哈希。

cues.en: And if that doesn't work, fail.
cues.zh: 如果查找失败，就调用 fail。

cues.en: Now I could have written die there but die is very intense.
cues.zh: 我这里本来可以写 die，但 die 实在太剧烈了。

cues.en: Fail says, yeah, die but make it savable,
cues.zh: fail 的意思是：虽然要中断，但允许被捕获挽救，

cues.en: which is very very cool as well.
cues.zh: 这同样非常非常酷。

cues.en: So if I look up my rule, then I wanna look in this little hash that I found and find out what to do on the tape, what to do with the state, and what to do with the head.
cues.zh: 查到规则后，我想查看找到的这个小哈希，确定要在纸带上做什么、对状态做什么，以及对读写头做什么。

cues.en: So what I'm gonna do is I'm gonna look up three
cues.zh: 所以我要做的是查找三个

cues.en: entries
cues.zh: 条目，

cues.en: in that hash.
cues.zh: 从那个哈希里查找。

cues.en: But to have the hash available to me, I want to given it.
cues.zh: 但为了方便使用这个哈希，我想对它用 given。

cues.en: And it just like Pearl five, given says, make that hash that I've looked up dollar underscore.
cues.zh: 就像 Perl 5 一样，given 会把查到的哈希赋值给 $_。

cues.en: So now I look up the hash and I do it in a way that you've probably not even imagined before.
cues.zh: 现在我来查找哈希，用的是一种你们以前可能都想不到的方式。

cues.en: In Pearl six, if you want to default to dollar underscore,
cues.zh: 在 Perl 6 中，如果你想默认使用 $_，

cues.en: you can still do so, but you just can't do so magically.
cues.zh: 依然可以这么做，只是不能再那么隐式魔术化了。

cues.en: So in Pearl six, none of the built ins default to dollar underscore
cues.zh: 所以在 Perl 6 中，没有任何内置函数会默认使用 $_，

cues.en: Because in Pearl five, only 40% of the built ins default to dollar underscore. And how many know exactly the 40%?
cues.zh: 因为在 Perl 5 里，只有 40% 的内置函数默认使用 $_。又有谁能确切说出是哪 40% 呢？

cues.en: I'm watching Larry's not put his hand up either.
cues.zh: 我看到 Larry 也没举手。

cues.en: So in Pearl six, if you wanna default to dollar underscore, you say dot in front of the thing because that's the same as saying,
cues.zh: 所以在 Perl 6 里，如果你想默认用 $_，就在对象前面加点，因为这等同于说：

cues.en: look up the method on the object that's in dollar underscore and that object is a hash.
cues.zh: 在 $_ 里的那个对象上查找方法，而那个对象是一个哈希。

cues.en: So I do a hash look up.
cues.zh: 所以我是做一次哈希查找。

cues.en: Now, you'll note that I'm using angle brackets rather than curlies. I could still use curlies, but in PERL six, curlies don't auto quote.
cues.zh: 现在你会注意到，我用的是尖括号而不是花括号。我仍然可以用花括号，但在 Perl 6 里，花括号不会自动加引号。

cues.en: And that's actually a feature, not a bug.
cues.zh: 这其实是特性，不是缺陷。

cues.en: Because if you've ever done auto quoting in PERL five when you didn't mean to,
cues.zh: 因为如果你曾在 Perl 5 里不小心自动加过引号，

cues.en: you'll realize that it's kind of nice that we have a separate notation that just looks it up.
cues.zh: 你就会明白，有一个只负责查找的独立写法其实挺不错。

cues.en: Now, the thing is in these rules, there might not be any instruction to write something on the tape. There might not be a state change. So we also have to say only do that if we've defined something in this particular hash that tells me what to write or what state to go into.
cues.zh: 现在，问题是在这些规则里，可能根本没有在纸带上写东西的指令。也可能没有状态变化。所以我们还得规定：只有在这个特定哈希里定义了告诉我该写什么或进入什么状态的内容时，才执行这些操作。

cues.en: So in other words, I'm going to look up something to write onto the tape if it's there, look up something to change the state if it's there, and I'm gonna look up something to see if there's a move to make and I'm just gonna add it to the head position. So all the moves are relative in a Turing machine, move left, move right. Of course, if they haven't got anything there, it'll be move undef which will go to zero and I won't care.
cues.zh: 换句话说，如果纸带上有要写的东西，我就查出来写上去；如果有要改状态的东西，我就查出来改状态；我还会查一下有没有要做的移动，然后把它加到磁头位置上。所以在图灵机里，所有移动都是相对的：左移、右移。当然，如果那里什么都没有，就会是 move undef，这会变成零，而我不在乎。

cues.en: But the problem is this pattern is very very common. I want to assign something but only if the something is defined.
cues.zh: 但问题是，这种模式非常非常常见。我想赋一个值，但只在这个值已定义时才赋。

cues.en: Now, there is not an operator to do that. There's not in PERL five either. If you're thinking of the slash slash equals, that's not what slash slash equals does.
cues.zh: 现在，没有运算符能做到这一点。Perl 5 里也没有。如果你想到的是 //=，那不是 //= 做的事。

cues.en: But I like this pattern. Only do the assignment if the thing you're assigning is there.
cues.zh: 但我喜欢这种模式。只在你赋的东西存在时才做赋值。

cues.en: Kinda makes sense.
cues.zh: 还挺合理的。

cues.en: I thought I would like to have that available all the time. Well, Pearl six
cues.zh: 我想让这个功能一直可用。嗯，Perl 6

cues.en: makes that incredibly easy.
cues.zh: 让这件事变得极其简单。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: How do I make that a permanent part of my language? Well, the answer is I factor it out up here, assign the r value if the r value is defined,
cues.zh: 我怎么把它变成语言里永久的一部分？答案是，我在上面把它抽出来：如果 r 值已定义，就赋这个 r 值，

cues.en: and I write myself a new operator.
cues.zh: 然后给自己写一个新运算符。

cues.en: One that's never been seen before.
cues.zh: 一个前所未见的运算符。

cues.en: So the name of that operator is assign.
cues.zh: 所以这个运算符的名字叫 assign。

cues.en: It takes an l value which is read writable. It takes an r value which is only readable,
cues.zh: 它接收一个可读写的 l 值。它接收一个只读的 r 值，

cues.en: and it assigns the r value to the l value if the r value is defined.
cues.zh: 并且如果 r 值已定义，就把 r 值赋给 l 值。

cues.en: And now down here, can just say assign
cues.zh: 现在在下面，我就可以直接写 assign

cues.en: to write, assign to state,
cues.zh: 给 write 赋值，给 state 赋值，
